status: current proposed lifecycle specification, empirical V&V not executed
scope: Mission gates and direct MR/FR and UC/scenario parents only

mission_requirements.text: The EPS engineering enterprise shall obtain MCR acceptance at the end of Pre-Phase A for a mission concept whose EPS feasibility is justified against agreed stakeholder expectations and mission constraints, supported by initial ConOps, technical budgets, assumptions, risks and a preliminary verification and validation approach.

The enterprise shall obtain SRR acceptance during Phase A for validated EPS requirements and interfaces traced to the mission concept and allocated spacecraft requirements, with measurable criteria consistent with stakeholder expectations.
The enterprise shall obtain MDR/SDR acceptance at the end of Phase A for a credible EPS architecture with requirement allocations and justified alternatives.

The enterprise shall obtain PDR acceptance at the end of Phase B for a sized, compatible preliminary EPS design supported by sizing and trades, margins, risk dispositions, controlled interfaces and verification and validation plans against applicable requirements and agreed technical resource and risk limits.

mission_requirements.timing: during adapted Phase C, before deliverable coding
mission_requirements.text: The enterprise shall obtain scoped CDR acceptance during adapted Phase C, before deliverable coding, for complete detailed EPS model and software designs, interface specifications and implementation, integration and verification and validation plans.

The enterprise shall obtain scoped SIR acceptance at the end of adapted Phase C for released EPS models and declared control and interface software for host execution, applicable MIL/SIL evidence, compatible interfaces and ready integration configurations and procedures.

shared_gate_success_conditions: The following success conditions apply to all six mission requirements. The enterprise shall establish and maintain coherent phase baselines through authorized changes, repeated affected checks and applicable verification and validation evidence, retaining configuration-linked requirements, expectations, methods, results, limitations and finding dispositions. It shall obtain and retain acceptance decisions from the designated review authority against agreed success criteria, prevent progression with blocking findings, and record conditional limits, closure actions, owners and dates. A prepared package supports entrance to review. Acceptance requires an explicit authorized accepted decision.
continued_refinement: The enterprise shall derive, refine and validate EPS and component requirements and interfaces as the design matures through Phase B and adapted C. Changes can reopen earlier work.
